author: Lan
changelog:
# Changelog

## 0.1.0

- Initial release of the configurable Session Titles plugin.
- Generate a title after the first completed turn using the configured prompt,
  model, and thinking level.
- Preserve manually renamed session titles.
description: Generate concise titles for new sessions with a configurable prompt, model, and thinking level.

en.name: Session Titles
en.description: Generate concise titles for new sessions with a configurable prompt, model, and thinking level.
en.safetyNotes: After the first completed turn, the plugin sends bounded excerpts of the first user prompt and assistant reply to the selected model through PI-Desktop's plugin completion API. It requires the high-risk session.autoTitle and agent.complete permissions. It does not read full transcripts or provider credentials, and manual renames are preserved.
